pdf_page_count fails when the supplied password does not authenticate the document

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
begin
  pdf_bytes = File.read("pdf/password_protected.pdf").bytes
  result = Xberg.pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes, 'xberg-test-fake-wrong-password-1879')
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
